title: It's OK
text: It's OK. I ordered this to organize gift-wrap and I was not that impressed.  Granted it's the first organizer for gift-wrap I've ordered so I don't know if my expectations were off or I'm just too picky.  The thing feels a bit cheaply made like it won't keep that long, which is ok since it wasn't that expensive and I am not that into it but worth noting.  I found the segments a little awkward, the opening for scissors won't work with regular sized scissors, not sure what size they think most people have - baby scissors? the tape side ( I think that's what it is for) is also laughably small.  So in summary  - it's OK but I wouldn't get too excited about it.
